crossRefs.note: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah…
When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him…
Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.
“Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh and also with men.
Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and Yahweh blessed him.
The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to…
The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

people.name: Hannah
people.line: The mother of the prophet Samuel.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So the LORD attended to Hannah, and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.
translations.asv: And Jehovah visited Hannah, and she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before Jehovah.
